palette.title: The knowledge palette
palette.intro: Six domains, one kitchen. Each colour is a body of work I bring to the pass — select a swatch to see what is behind it.

chips.name: Culinary craft
chips.summary: Sixteen years of cooking across fine dining, grill, seafood and banquet — at volume and at detail.
points: Fine dining, Mediterranean and Italian
Steakhouse & grill, fresh seafood
Hotel, banquet and event production
Menu development from concept to plate
Michelin-starred guest chef events and gourmet festivals hosted on board

chips.name: Operations & cost control
chips.summary: Kitchens that make sense on the plate and on the P&L.
points: Menu engineering and recipe costing
P&L ownership, food cost and labour control
Procurement and supply chain — including sourcing under import restrictions
Multi-unit management: 4 concepts and a 25-person brigade at once
Built and sold a food-delivery business as a profitable going concern

chips.name: Food safety & HACCP
chips.summary: Standards that hold on a busy Saturday, not just on audit day.
points: HACCP certified; HACCP plans built from scratch
Allergen management and labelling
Colour-coded systems, logs and daily checks
Five seasons under luxury cruise-line brand standards
Audit readiness built into routine, not added before inspection

chips.name: People & training
chips.summary: More than 2,000 cooks trained, assessed and placed.
points: Two fleet-wide training cycles a year, 350–400 recruits each
Competency frameworks and assessment per position
Staff certification and progression paths
Calm, clear standard-setting — new methods adopted within days
Team building in existing brigades, not only new ones

chips.name: Pre-opening & project leadership
chips.summary: From empty kitchen to first service — on schedule.
points: 8 restaurant concepts opened in 12 months (Orenburg, Russia)
New-vessel openings every spring on the cruise fleet
Resort hotel F&B pre-opening consulting
Day-by-day training plans and readiness programmes
Cross-department master planning for a 200+ room hotel

chips.name: Languages
chips.summary: I lead in the language the team thinks in.
points: Serbian — native
English — fluent, daily working language
Russian — fluent, years of work in Russia and the CIS market
